title: 50agents vs Lindy: assistant or workspace | 50agents
description: 50agents vs Lindy: Lindy is an AI assistant in Slack, iMessage and email, billed per user; 50agents builds AI agents, automations and apps for a workspace.
answer: Pick Lindy for one AI assistant that works in Slack, iMessage and email.
Pick 50agents for AI agents, automations and apps for the whole workspace, free to start.
line: AI agents, automations and apps for the whole workspace, free to start.

faqs.q: Is 50agents an AI assistant like Lindy?
faqs.a: Partly. 50agents builds AI agents like Lindy, plus automations, browser agents and apps, all from one chat with Captain.

faqs.q: How is Lindy priced for a team?
faqs.a: Lindy Team starts at $29.99 a month for 3,000 credits, billed for every active user. 50agents is free to start.
Yes. Lindy waits for your OK on outside actions, and 50agents holds anything that reaches people outside in Needs you.
50agents is free to start. Lindy gives $50 in free credits that last 7 days, then Team starts at $29.99 a month.
Lindy drives a browser on Pro and up. 50agents browser agents work websites with no app to connect, on a schedule, and leave a report.

faqs.q: Does 50agents work inside Slack or email?
faqs.a: Lindy works in Slack, iMessage and email. In 50agents you tell Captain what you need and it builds an app, an automation, an AI agent or a browser agent.

faqs.q: Can I move my Lindy setup over?
faqs.a: There is no import. Note what each one does, then describe it to Captain, which shows a plan before it builds.
